# Psalm 68 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-David. A-psalm. A-song.

**2** God arises; His-enemies are-scattered, and-those-hating-Him flee from-His-face.

**3** As-smoke is-driven, You-drive-[them]; as-wax melts before fire, the-wicked perish before God.

**4** But-the-righteous are-glad; they-exult before God and-rejoice with-gladness.

**5** Sing to-God, sing-praises to-His-name; lift-up [a song] to-the-One-riding through-the-deserts — Yah [is] His-name — and-exult before-Him.

**6** Father of-orphans and-judge of-widows [is] God in-His-holy dwelling.

**7** God settles the-lonely in-a-home; He-brings-out prisoners to-prosperity; but the-rebellious dwell in-a-parched-land.

**8** O-God, when-You-went-out before Your-people, when-You-marched through-the-wilderness — Selah —

**9** the-earth shook, indeed the-heavens dripped before God — this [one] Sinai — before God, the-God of-Israel.

**10** Rain in-abundance You-shed, O-God; Your-inheritance — and-it-was-weary — You-established-it.

**11** Your-creatures dwelt in-it; You-provided in-Your-goodness for-the-afflicted, O-God.

**12** The-Lord gives the-word; the-women-who-announce [the news are] a-great host:

**13** 'Kings of-armies flee, they-flee!' And-the-woman-at-home divides the-plunder.

**14** Though you-lie among-the-sheepfolds — wings of-a-dove covered-with-silver, and-her-pinions with-greenish-gold.

**15** When-the-Almighty scattered kings in-it, it-snowed in-Zalmon.

**16** O-mountain of-God, mountain of-Bashan! O-many-peaked mountain, mountain of-Bashan!

**17** Why do-you-look-with-envy, O-many-peaked mountains, at-the-mountain God-desired for-His-dwelling? Indeed YHWH dwells [there] forever.

**18** The-chariots of-God [are] myriads, thousands upon-thousands; the-Lord [is] among-them — Sinai in-holiness.

**19** You-ascended on-high; You-led captivity captive; You-received gifts among-men, and-even [among] the-rebellious, for-the-dwelling of-Yah God.

**20** Blessed [is] the-Lord; day by-day He-bears [our burden] for-us — the-God [who is] our-salvation. Selah.

**21** The-God for-us [is] a-God of-salvations; and-to-YHWH the-Lord [belong] the-exits from-death.

**22** Indeed God crushes the-head of-His-enemies, the-hairy crown of-the-one-walking in-his-guilt.

**23** The-Lord said, 'From-Bashan I-will-bring-back; I-will-bring-back from-the-depths of-the-sea,

**24** that you-may-strike your-foot in-blood, the-tongue of-your-dogs — from-enemies — its-portion.'

**25** They-have-seen Your-processions, O-God, the-processions of-my-God, my-King, into-the-sanctuary.

**26** Singers in-front, musicians behind, in-the-midst maidens playing-tambourines.

**27** 'In-the-assemblies bless God, the-Lord, [you who are] from-the-fountain of-Israel.'

**28** There [is] Benjamin, the-youngest, ruling-them; the-princes of-Judah — their-throng; the-princes of-Zebulun, the-princes of-Naphtali.

**29** Your-God has-commanded your-strength; show-strength, O-God, You-who-have-worked for-us.

**30** From-Your-temple over Jerusalem, kings bring tribute to-You.

**31** Rebuke the-beast of-the-reeds, the-herd of-bulls among-the-calves of-the-peoples, trampling-down those-delighting in-pieces of-silver; scatter the-peoples who-delight in-wars.

**32** Envoys come from-Egypt; Cush stretches-out its-hands to-God.

**33** O-kingdoms of-the-earth, sing to-God; sing-praises to-the-Lord — Selah —

**34** to-the-One-riding in-the-heavens, the-heavens of-old. Behold, He-gives His-voice, a-mighty voice.

**35** Ascribe strength to-God; over Israel [is] His-majesty, and-His-strength [is] in-the-clouds.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **68:6**: 'Father of orphans and judge of widows' — God's identity is defined by His care for the most vulnerable. This is not sentiment but identity.

- **68:19**: Paul quotes this verse in Ephesians 4:8 — 'He ascended on high, leading captives' — applying it to Christ's ascension and the giving of spiritual gifts.

— EMET
